purpose: Automated monitoring of authoritative SEBI, AMFI, RBI, MeitY, Government of India, Income Tax, Consumer Affairs and CERT-In sources relevant to Luxmi InvestCare as an AMFI-registered Mutual Fund Distributor and website operator.
monitoringLimitations: Current watcher stores source-byte SHA-256 hashes; it does not extract, normalize or semantically diff source text.
Dynamic pages may cause false-positive review triggers. A hash change is not itself proof of a regulatory amendment.
Static Gazette PDFs are reference copies and will not detect a later amendment unless the source list is updated.
Monitoring coverage is not exhaustive and does not replace professional compliance review.
